speaker: KANNAN
text: Anna! Morning-la kudutha tea-ku 500 rs UPI la stuck ayiduchu! IPPO ENGA?

speaker: YUNA
text: Thambi ore tension! Network busy! Server romba slow-ah irukku pa!

speaker: BUGGY
text: Alert! Server timeout. Unga UPI amount automatic-ah 3 days-la reverse aagum!

speaker: KANNAN
text: Ennaathu 3 days-ah? Appo indha morning tea free-ah? CHA?

speaker: YUNA
text: Free illa thambi! Adhu oru technical gateway delay!

speaker: BUGGY
text: Correct! API failure-ku bank 24 hours window kuduthurukku!

speaker: KANNAN
text: Oh! Appo adha solla vendiyathu thanae! IPPO LUCK!

speaker: YUNA
text: Adhane! Inga oru cup tea kuduthu waste aagala pa!
